name: Wound Dressings
summary: Brother Lowley at Farholde Keep needs cloth for bandages. Farholde has no steady way to make cloth, and its supply is running low.

sections.title: A Short Supply
sections.body: At Farholde Keep, Brother Lowley asks you to help as quality cloth grows scarce. The keep relies on imports from goblins or cloth taken from orcs. Without more, Lowley may have to make bandages from old shirts, while the fighting force needs them to save lives.

faq.q: Why does Brother Lowley need cloth?
faq.answer: Farholde needs cloth to make bandages, and its supply of quality cloth is running low.

faq.q: Why can't Farholde make its own cloth?
faq.answer: Farholde has no reliable way to manufacture cloth, so it depends on imports from goblins or cloth taken from orcs.

faq.q: What happens if the cloth runs out?
faq.answer: Brother Lowley may have to make bandages from old shirts.
Brother Lowley at Farholde Keep asks you to gather Mageweave Cloth.
